summary: This directory orchestrates the automated JSDoc update pipeline, covering the lifecycle from project context extraction and update planning to the execution of documentation modifications via configurable strategies.
responsibilities: Orchestrate JSDoc documentation updates across source files
Model the metadata and context for documentable code symbols
Define structured plans for merging and updating JSDoc content
Resolve appropriate update strategies based on code complexity
Execute documentation modification tasks within the codebase
relationships: The JSDoc update pipeline relies on context definitions to analyze source code symbols and determine documentation requirements.
Update plans generated by the schema component serve as the roadmap for the execution engine to perform specific merge actions.
The mode resolver evaluates code complexity to inform how the execution engine applies documentation changes.
Execution logic bridges the gap between planned documentation updates and actual source code modifications.
designDecisions: Use of hierarchical, node-based structures to represent documentable code entities.
Decoupling of documentation planning and strategy resolution from execution logic.
Implementation of deterministic schema definitions for all proposed documentation changes.
Use of a strategy pattern for managing update modes and complexity analysis.
